title: Lin Langtian's Pressure
summary: Lin Dong wakes at Yuan Dan perfect, and the furious Ling Qingzhu attacks him for disgracing her but stops short of killing him. Qin Shi, Wang Yan and Lin Langtian break in, see that the Nirvana Heart is taken, and Ling Qingzhu turns aside Wang Yan's invitation and leaves. Wang Yan accuses Lin Dong of stealing the Wang Clan's Soul Treasure, and Lin Ke-er says Wang Pan is lying. Lin Langtian learns Lin Dong is from a side branch and orders him to hand the halberd to Wang Yan and apologize to Wang Pan. When Lin Dong refuses, Lin Langtian offers to forget it if Lin Dong can walk out of the main hall under his Qi Creation pressure. Thinking of Qing Tan and his family, Lin Dong crawls and stands through the pressure and makes it out. He swears to repay this a hundredfold, and Lin Langtian admits this ant is not ordinary.
events: Lin Dong finds he is Yuan Dan perfect; Ling Qingzhu attacks him for what happened in the tomb.
Qin Shi, Wang Yan and Lin Langtian arrive; Ling Qingzhu downplays the fight.
Ling Qingzhu turns down Wang Yan's invitation and leaves after Lin Dong concedes a rematch.
Wang Yan and Wang Pan claim the Ancient Heavenly Scales Halberd; Lin Ke-er and others back Lin Dong.
Lin Langtian orders Lin Dong to give up the halberd and apologize; Lin Dong refuses.
Lin Langtian dares him to walk out of the main hall under his Qi Creation pressure.
Lin Dong pushes through the pressure and walks out, vowing revenge.
cultivation: Lin Dong is now Yuan Dan perfect. Lin Langtian is at Qi Creation.
